Prohibition Notice issued to Keighley and Worth Valley Railway Preservation Society Limited

  • Issue date: 28 June 2022
  • Status: Complied
  • Public register ID: P/20220628/KWVR/SJS/01

The Keighley and Worth Valley Railway Preservation Society Limited have failed to ensure that steam locomotive 'Bahamas' (number 45596) is not used or operated until a competent person has undertaken a thorough examination of the locomotive's boiler.

Prohibition Notice issued to Gwili Railway Company Limited

  • Issue date: 28 June 2022
  • Status: Complied
  • Public register ID: P/20220628/GWILI/SJS/01

Gwili Railway Company Limited have failed to ensure that diesel locomotive Class 14 (D9523) is not used until appropriate repairs have been made to the engine's fuel system to prevent the risk of fire.

Prohibition Notice issued to Wensleydale Railway PLC

  • Issue date: 15 March 2022
  • Status: In Force
  • Public register ID: P/MB15032022

Wensleydale Railway PLC have failed to ensure that passengers are not permitted to board or alight from trains at Leeming Bar station until suitable and sufficient measures are in place to protect them from the risk of falling between the train and the platform.

Prohibition Notice issued to Colne Valley Railway Preservation Society

  • Issue date: 10 January 2022
  • Status: Complied
  • Public register ID: P/KB10012022

Colne Valley Railway Preservation Society have failed to prohibit the use of the level crossing at Castle Hedingham until a suitable risk assessment has been completed and appropriate safety measures implemented.

Prohibition Notice issued to Network Rail Infrastructure Limited

  • Issue date: 5 January 2022
  • Status: Complied
  • Public register ID: P/20220105/NR/SJS/01

Network Rail Infrastructure Limited have failed to ensure that work on the overhead line equipment at Crewe station is prohibited until a safe system of work is established that adequately controls the risks from electrical contact.
